title: fagara micrantha
intro: Fagara micrantha, commonly known as Zanthoxylum micranthum, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family. It is a shrub or small tree native to Southeast Asia, used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Fagara micrantha include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which may help to alleviate conditions such as fever, headache, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Fagara micrantham include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and volatile oils, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties.
